headers.it: Cabu tarikkung, John Marka loe, Jesu hnukbang hatlai hnetto thungah kathum kami na ai ni. Toe anih ih ahmin loe cabu kangtha thungah amtueng pop parai. Marka mah kapop koek ah thuih ih Jesu kawng loe Piter khae hoiah ni angzoh, tiah poekhaih tawn kaminawk doeh oh o. Marka cabu thungah loe cabu kangquem thung ih lok maeto khue ni patoh (1.2-3), kaalok kawng thui ai pongah, Judah kaminawk hanah tarik ih cabu na ai, Judah kaminawk hanah tarik ai, Rom kaminawk hanah ni tarik, tiah amtueng. Hae cabu thungah loe Jesu toksakhaih hoi patukhaih kawng to oh, Jesu loe Sithaw Capa tangtang ni, anih loe tang han koiah oh, anih hnukah bang han doeh ating, tiah amtuengsak. Hae cabu loe A.D 70 thuemtham ah tarik kalang mue, tiah poekhaih tawnh o.

verses.text:
\s1 Tuinuem paekkung Johan  
\r (Mathai 3.1-12; Luka 3.1-18; Johan 1.19-28)
Sithaw Capa, kahoih Jesu Kri tamthanglok AMTONGHAIH loe hae tiah oh;
\x - \xo 1:2 \xt Mal 3.1.\x*tahmaanawk mah hae tiah tarik ih oh, Khenah, na hma ah tamthanglok sinkung kang patoeh, anih mah na hma ah na loklam to tuh tih.
\x - \xo 1:3 \xt Isaiah 40.3.\x*Praezaek ah hang kami mah, Nangcae mah Angraeng ih loklam to paroep oh loe, a caehhaih loklamnawk to patoengh oh, tiah thuih.
Johan mah praezaek ah tuinuemhaih to paek moe, zaehaihnawk tahmen hanah, dawnpakhuem tuinuemhaih lok to thuih.
Judea prae kaminawk boih hoi Jerusalem ih kaminawk loe anih khaeah caeh o moe, angmacae zaehaihnawk to taphong o pacoengah, anih mah Jordan vapui ah tuinuemhaih to paek boih.
\x - \xo 1:6 \xt 2 Siang 1.8.\x*Johan loe kaengkuu hrang moihin to angkhuk moe, moihin kaengkaeh to kaengah angzaeng; pakhuh hoi khoitui to buh ah a caak;
anih mah, Kai pongah kalen kue kami loe ka hnuk ah angzoh, kai loe takhum moe, anih ih khokpanai qui khram pae han mataeng doeh kam cuk ai.

Kai mah loe tui hoiah ni tuinuemhaih kang paek o: toe anih mah loe Kacai Muithla hoiah tuinuemhaih na paek o tih, tiah a thuih.   
\s1 Tuinuemhaih hoi pacuekhaih  
\r (Mathai 3.13; 4.11; Luka 3.21-22; 4.1-13)
Jesu loe Kalili prae Nazareth vangpui hoiah angzoh moe, Jordan vapui ah Johan mah tuinuemhaih to paek.
Jesu tui thung hoi angthawk tahang naah, vannawk to am-ongh moe, a nuiah anghum tathuk pahu baktih Muithla to a hnuk:

\x - \xo 1:11 \xt Genesis 22.2; Saam 2.7; Isaiah 42.1; Mathai 3.17; 12.18; Mark 9.7; Luk 3.22.\x*to naah van hoiah, Nang loe ka palung duek ih Capa ah na oh, a nuiah kang hoe parai, tiah lok angzoh tathuk.
Akra ai ah Muithla mah Anih to praezaek ah caeh haih.
Anih loe ni quipalito thung praezaek ah oh moe, Setan pacuekhaih to a tongh; kasan moinawk hoi nawnto a oh; van kaminawk mah anih ih tok to sak pae o.
Johan thongim krak pacoengah, Jesu Kalili prae ah angzoh moe, Sithaw mah siangpahrang ah ukhaih prae ih kahoih tamthanglok to taphong.

\x - \xo 1:15 \xt Mathai 3.2.\x*\wj Atue akoep boeh, Sithaw mah siangpahrang ah ukhaih prae loe zoi boeh: dawnpakhuem oh loe, kahoih tamthanglok to tang oh, \wj* tiah taphong.   
\s1 Jesu mah hnukbang palito kawk  
\r (Mathai 4.12-22; Luka 4.14-15; 5.1-11)
Anih Kalili tuipui taengah caeh naah, tuipui thungah palok haeng Simon hoi amnawk Andru to a hnuk, nihnik loe tanga naeh kami ah oh hoi.
Jesu mah nihnik khaeah, Ka hnukah bang hoih, kami naehkung ah kang sak hoi han, tiah a naa.
Nihnik mah angmah hnik ih palok to a caeh hoi taak moe, Anih hnukah bang hoi.
To ahmuen hoi kangthla kue ah a caeh pacoengah, palong thungah angmah hnik ih palok pading, Zebedi ih caa Jakob hoi amnawk Johan to a hnuk.

Nihnik to a kawk roep: nihnik loe ampa Zebedi hoi tamnanawk to caeh hoi taak moe, Anih hnukah caeh hoi.   
\s1 Taqawk sae haek  
\r (Luka 4.31-37)
Nihcae loe Kapernuam vangpui ah caeh o; Sabbath niah loe Sineko thungah akun moe, kaminawk to patuk.
\x - \xo 1:22 \xt Mathai 7.28,29.\x*Anih loe ca tarik kaminawk baktiah patuk ai, sakthaihaih tawn kami baktiah patuk pongah, anih patukhaih to nihcae mah dawrai o.
Nihcae ih Sineko thungah taqawk sae tawn kami maeto oh; anih loe hang moe,
nang Nazareth Jesu, kaimacae hmawk ah om o ue; kaicae hoi nang asaenghaih timaw oh? Kaicae amroksak han ih maw nang zoh? Nang loe mi maw, tito ka panoek, Ciimcai Sithaw Maeto, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah, \wj anghngai duem ah loe, anih takoh thung hoi tacawt ah, \wj* tiah zoeh.
Taqawk sae mah anih to asoek naah, anih loe tha hoi hangh moe, anih takoh thung hoiah tacawt.

To naah nihcae boih dawnrai o, hae loe kawbaktih hmuen maw? Kawbaktih patukhaih kangtha maw? Anih mah sakthaihaih hoiah lok to thuih naah, kahoih ai taqawknawk mah mataeng doeh anih ih lok to tahngaih pae o, tiah angmacae hoi angmacae lok angdueng o.

Akra ai ah anih kawng to Kalili prae boih ah amthang.   
\s1 Taqawk haek moe ngantuisakhaih  
\r (Mathai 8.14-17; Luka 4.38-41)
Sineko hoi tacawt o pacoengah, Jakob, Johan, Simon hoi nawnto Andru im ah a caeh o.
Toe Simon amsae nongpata loe ngannat moe, angsong sut, tiah nihcae mah Jesu khaeah thuih pae o.
Anih loe angzoh moe, nongpata ih ban to patawnh pae pacoengah, pathawk tahang; to naah nongpata loe ngantui roep moe, nihcae khetzawnhaih tok to a sak pae.
Duembang, ni akun naah loe nathaih congca tawn kaminawk hoi taqawk sae tawn kaminawk anih khaeah angzoh o haih.

Anih mah nathaih congca tawn pop parai kaminawk to ngan a tuisak, pop parai kahoih ai taqawknawk to a haek; nihcae mah anih loe mi maw tito panoek o pongah, taqawknawk to lok apae sak ai.   
\s1 Jesu Kalili ah tamthanglok thuih
Anih loe akhawnbang khawnthaw, khodai ai naah angthawk moe, kamding rue ahmuen ah caeh pacoengah, to ah lawk a thuih.
Simon hoi nawnto kaom kaminawk mah anih to pakrong o.
Anih to hnuk o naah, kaminawk boih mah nang ang pakrong o, tiah a thuih pae o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, A taengah \wj kaom vangpui ah caeh o si, to ah tamthanglok ka thuih han, \wj* tiah a naa.

\x - \xo 1:39 \xt Mathai 4.23; 9.35.\x*Anih loe Kalili prae thung ih Sineko boih ah tamthanglok to thuih moe, taqawknawk to a haek.   
\s1 Ngansae man kami ngantui  
\r (Mathai 8.1-4; Luka 5.12-16)
Ngansae man kami maeto anih khaeah angzoh moe, khokkhu cangkrawn pacoengah, anih khaeah, Na koeh nahaeloe, kai hae nang ciimsak thaih, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah tahmen pongah, a ban payangh moe, anih to sui, anih khaeah, \wj Ka koeh; ciim lai ah, \wj* tiah a naa.
To tiah a thuih pacoeng akra ai ah, ngansae nathaih to hoih pae roep, anih loe kaciim ah oh.
Anih mah kahoihah lokthuih pae moe, to kami to patoeh ving;

\x - \xo 1:44 \xt LEV 14.1-32.\x*to kami khaeah, \wj Mi khaeah doeh thui hmah; toe caeh ah loe qaima khaeah ngan na tuihaih to patuek ah, nihcae khaeah hnukung ah oh hanah, Mosi mah paek ih kaalok baktih toengah hmuenpaekhaih to sah ah, \wj* tiah a naa.

Toe anih loe tasa bangah caeh moe, to kawng to thuih thai tawk a thuih pongah, ahmuen kruekah amthang, to pongah Jesu loe vangpui thungah kamtueng ah akun thai ai boeh, toe anih loe vangpui tasa bang ih kamding rue ahmuen ah oh: ahmuen kruek ih kaminawk anih khaeah angzoh o.

\s1 Khok ban dueh kami ngantui  
\r (Mathai 9.1-8; Luka 5.17-26)
Ni nazetto maw laemh pacoengah, anih loe Kapernuam vangpui ah akun let; anih im ah angzoh ti, tiah kaminawk mah thaih o.
Akra ai ah paroeai kaminawk nawnto amkhueng o, nihcae oh han ih ahmuen om ai khoek to kami to pop o, thok taeng khoek to ahmuen kong ai: anih mah to kaminawk khaeah lokthuih pae.
To naah khok ban angtawt thai ai nathaih tawn kami maeto loe, kami long palito mah angzawn o moe, anih khaeah angzoh o haih.

Kami pop o parai pongah to kaminawk loe anih taengah pha o thai ai, to naah nihcae mah anih ohhaih ahmuen thuem ah, imphu to phraek o moe, khok ban angtawt thai ai nathaih tawn kami to angsonghaih iihkhun hoi nawnto pakhrak o tathuk.
Jesu mah nihcae tanghaih to hnuk naah, khok ban angtawt thai ai nathaih tawn kami khaeah, Ka capa, na zaehaihnawk loe tahmen boeh, tiah a naa.
Thoemto ca tarik kaminawk doeh to ahmuen ah anghnut o toeng, angmacae palung thung hoiah,
tipongah hae kami mah Sithaw ih ahmin kasae thuih vai? Sithaw khue ai ah loe mi mah maw zae tahmen thai tih, tiah poek o.
Nihcae poekhaih to Jesu mah palung thung hoiah panoek pae naah, nihcae khaeah, \wj Tikhoe to tiah na poek o loe? \wj*

\wj Khok ban angtawt thai ai nathaih tawn kami khaeah, Na zaehaihnawk loe tahmen boeh, tiah thuih maw kazoi kue, to tih ai boeh loe angthawk ah, baih ih kahni to la ah loe, caeh ah, tiah thuih ih lok? \wj* tiah a naa.
\wj Toe Kami Capa loe long nuiah zaehaihnawk tahmen thaihaih to a tawnh, tito na panoek o thai hanah (anih mah khok ban angtawt thai ai nathaih tawn kami khaeah,) \wj*
\wj kang thuih o, Angthawk ah, baih ih kahni to la ah loe, nangmah im ah caeh ah, \wj* tiah a naa.

Anih loe angthawk phrat moe, a baih ih kahni to lak pacoengah, nihcae boih hma ah caeh; to ah kaom kaminawk boih dawnrai o, hae baktih hmuen ka hnu o vai ai, tiah a thuih o moe, Sithaw to saphaw o.   
\s1 Mathai kawkhaih  
\r (Mathai 9.9-13; Luka 5.27-32)
To pacoengah anih loe tuipui taengah caeh let; to naah paroeai kaminawk anih khaeah angzoh o, nihcae to anih mah patuk.
To ahmuen hoi tacawt naah, tamut conghaih ahmuen ah anghnu Alphaeus capa Levi to a hnuk, anih khaeah, Ka hnukah bang ah, tiah a naa. Anih loe angthawk moe, anih hnukah bang.
Jesu anih im ah buhcaak han anghnut naah, tamut cong kaminawk, kazae kaminawk, a hnukbang kaminawk loe Jesu hoi nawnto anghnut o: pop parai kaminawk anih hnukah bang o.

Kazae kaminawk, tamut cong kaminawk hoi nawnto buh kacaa Anih to, ca tarik kaminawk hoi Farasinawk mah hnuk o, to naah nihcae mah a hnukbang kaminawk khaeah, Tipongah anih loe kazae kaminawk, tamut cong kaminawk hoi nawnto buh a caak loe? tiah a naa o.

Jesu mah to lok to thaih naah, anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Ngantui kaminawk loe siboi angai ai, nganna kaminawk mah ni angaih: kai loe katoeng kaminawk kawk hanah kang zo ai, kazae kaminawk dawnpakhuemsak hanah ni kang zoh, \wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Buhzahhaih  
\r (Mathai 9.13-17; Luka 5.33-39)

Johan hnukbang kaminawk hoi Farasinawk loe buh zah o: nihcae loe angzoh o moe, Anih khaeah, Johan hoi Farasi hnukbang kaminawk loe buhzah o, toe tipongah na hnukbang kaminawk loe buh zaa o ai loe? tiah a naa o.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Zu la kami oh nathuem ah, zu la kami ih ampuinawk mah buh to zaa o tih maw? Zu la kami oh nathung nihcae mah buh zaa o thai mak ai. \wj*
\wj Toe nihcae khae hoi zulakung lak vinghaih ni to om tih, to aninawk to phak naah loe nihcae mah buh to zaa o tih. \wj*
\wj Mi mah doeh kahni kangquem to kangtha hoiah abu vai ai: to tiah abu nahaeloe kahni ngan kangtha mah kangquem to azuk ueloe, prawn aep tih. \wj*

\wj Mi mah doeh misurtui kangtha to moihin pailang kangquem thungah lawn vai ai: to tiah lawn nahaeloe misurtui mah moihin pailang to tapoksak ueloe, tabu to amro tih: to pongah misurtui kangtha loe moihin pailang kangtha thungah ni lawn han oh, \wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Jesu loe Sabbath Angraeng  
\r (Mathai 12.1-8; Luka 6.1-5)
\x - \xo 2:23 \xt Deu 23.25.\x*Anih loe Sabbath niah lawk ah caeh; a caeh o nathuem ah, a hnukbang kaminawk mah cangqui to takoih o.
To naah Farasinawk mah anih khaeah, Khenah, tikhoe Sabbath niah sak han koi ai hmuennawk to na hnukbang kaminawk mah a sak o loe? tiah a naa o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj David mah zok amthlam naah, angaihaih baktiah, angmah hoi nawnto kaom kaminawk mah timaw sak o, tito na kroek o vai ai maw? \wj*

\x - \xo 2:26 \xt LEV 24.9.\x*\x - \xo 2:26 \xt 1 Sam 21.1-6.\x*\wj Kalen koek qaima Abiathar toksak nathuem ah, anih mah Sithaw imthung ah akun moe, kalen koek qaimanawk khue mah caak han koi, takaw to caak khue khawt ai ah, angmah hoi nawnto kaom kaminawk hanah doeh a paek to loe, \wj* tiah a naa.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Sabbath loe kami hanah ni sak, kami loe Sabbath hanah sah ai. \wj*
\wj To pongah Kami Capa loe Sabbath Angraeng ah doeh oh, \wj* tiah a naa.
Anih loe Sineko ah akun let; to ah ban kadueh kami maeto oh.
Nihcae mah Anih zae net thai hanah, Sabbath niah anih mah to kami to ngantuisak tih vai, tiah a zing o.
Anih loe ban khaem kami khaeah, \wj Angdoe ah, \wj* tiah a naa.

To pacoengah anih mah nihcae khaeah, Sabbath niah tih hmuen maw sak han hoih, kahoih hmuen maw, to tih ai boeh loe kasae hmuen, hinghaih pahlong maw, to tih ai boeh loe paduek? tiah a naa. Toe nihcae loe angam o duem.
Nihcae loe palungthah o parai pongah, palungphui hoiah a khet moe, to kami khaeah, Na ban payang ah, tiah a naa. Anih mah ban to payangh: to naah kalah ban maeto baktih toengah hoih pae roep.

To pacoengah Farasinawk tacawt o moe, Anih to kawbangah maw hum thai han, tiah Herod ih kaminawk hoiah lok aram o.   
\s1 Jesu mah tuipui taengah ngantuisak
Jesu loe a hnukbang kaminawk hoi tuipui bangah caeh: to naah paroeai Kalili ih kaminawk, Judea ih kaminawk anih hnukah bang o,
Anih mah sak ih kalen parai hmuennawk to a thaih o naah, Jerusalem, Idumea prae, Jordan vapui zaeh ih kaminawk, Tura hoi Sidon vangpui taeng ih kaminawk anih khaeah angzoh o.

\x - \xo 3:9 \xt Mark 4.1; Luk 5.1-3.\x*Kami pop o parai pongah kaminawk mah Anih to et o han ai ah, Anih mah a hnukbang kaminawk khaeah, \wj Anih han palong kathoeng kae maeto suem o coek ah, \wj* tiah a naa.
Pop parai kaminawk ngan a tuisak pongah, nathaih tawn paroeai kaminawk loe anih sui hanah hmabang ah anghnawt o.
Kasae taqawknawk mah anih to hnuk o naah, a hma ah tabok o moe, Nang loe Sithaw Capa ni, tiah hangh o.

Anih loe mi maw, tito kaminawk khaeah thuih o han ai ah, nihcae khaeah acoehaih lok to thuih pae.   
\s1 Kami hatlai hnettonawk patoeh  
\r (Mathai 1.1-4; Luka 4.12-16)
Anih loe mae nuiah dawh moe, a koeh ih kaminawk to kawk: to kaminawk loe anih khaeah caeh o.
Angmah hoi nawn oh o moe, nihcae to tamthanglok thui kami ah patoeh hanah, kami hatlai hnettonawk to tok a paek,
nathaih hoisak moe, taqawknawk haek thaihaih doeh a paek:
Simon to anih mah Piter, tiah ahmin paek;
Zebedi capa, Jakob hoi amnawk Johan hnik to, Boanerges tiah ahmin paek, to loe khopazih capa, tih haih ih ni:
Andru, Philip, Bartholomu, Mathai, Thomas, Alphaeus capa Jakob, Thadaeus, Kanaan kami Simon hoi,

Anih angphat taak, Juda Iskariot cae to tokpaek pacoengah, im maeto ah a caeh o.   
\s1 Jesu hoi Beelzabub  
\r (Mathai 12.12-32; Luka 11.14-23; 12.10)
Paroeai kaminawk loe buh caa ai ah, nawnto amkhueng o let bae.
Nihcae mah Anih loe amthu ving boeh, tiah thuih o ih lok to angmah ih kaminawk mah thaih o naah, Anih to patawnh hanah a caeh o.
\x - \xo 3:22 \xt Mathai 9.34; 10.25.\x*Jerusalem hoi angzo tathuk ca tarik kaminawk mah, Anih loe Beelzebub taqawk a tawnh, taqawk angraeng oephaih hoiah ni taqawknawk to a haek, tiah a naa o.
Nihcae to angmah khaeah a kawk moe, patahhaih lok a thuih pae, \wj Setan mah Setan to kawbangmaw haek thai tih? \wj*
\wj Siangpahrang mah uk ih prae doeh maeto hoi maeto ampraek nahaeloe, to siangpahrang prae loe angdoe thai mak ai. \wj*
\wj Imthung takoh doeh maeto hoi maeto ampraek nahaeloe, to imthung loe angdoe thai mak ai. \wj*
\wj Setan doeh angmah hoi angmah angkat moe, ampraek nahaeloe, angdoe thai mak ai, boenghaih ni pha tih. \wj*

\wj Thacak kami to taoeng hmaloe ai ah, anih ih hmuenmaenawk paro pae hanah, mi kawbaktih doeh anih imthung ah akun thai mak ai; taoengh pacoengah ni a imthung ih hmuenmaenawk to paro pae thai tih. \wj*
\wj Loktang kang thuih o, Kami capanawk zaehaih hoi Sithaw kasae a thuih o haih boih to tahmen tih: \wj*
\x - \xo 3:29 \xt Luk 12.10.\x*\wj toe Kacai Muithla kasae thui kami loe natuek naah doeh zae tahmenhaih om mak ai, dungzan lokcaekhaih tongh kami ah oh o: \wj*

nihcae mah kaciim ai taqawk sae a tawnh, tiah thuih o pongah to tiah lok a thuih.   
\s1 Jesu ih nawkamyanawk  
\r (Mathai 12.46-50; Luka 8.19-21)
Anih ih nawkamyanawk hoi amno loe to ahmuen ah angzoh o, tasa bangah angdoet o moe, Anih to kawk hanah kami to patoeh o.
Pop parai kaminawk loe Anih taengah anghnut takui o, to naah nihcae mah Anih khaeah, Khenah, nam no hoi nam nawkamyanawk mah tasa bangah ang pakrong o, tiah thuih pae o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Kam no maw, to tih ai boeh loe Kai ih nawkamyanawk loe mi aa? \wj* tiah a naa.
Anih mah a taengah anghnu kaminawk to khet moe, Khenah, hae kaminawk loe \wj Kam no hoi Kai ih nawkamya ah oh o! \wj*
\wj Mi kawbaktih doeh Sithaw koehhaih sah kami loe, Kam nawk, Ka tanuh hoi Kam no ah oh, \wj* tiah a naa.

\s1 Aanmu haehkung patahhaih  
\r (Mathai 13.1-9; Luka 8.4-8)

\x - \xo 4:1 \xt Luk 5.1-3.\x*Anih loe tuipui taengah kaminawk patuk amtong let bae: a taengah kami paroeai angpop o pongah, anih loe palong thungah akunh moe, anghnut; pop parai kaminawk loe tuicing ah oh o.
Anih mah paroeai hmuen kawng to patahhaih hoiah nihcae hanah patuk, anih mah patukhaih lok hoiah nihcae khaeah,
\wj tahngai oh; Khenah, aanmu haeh kami loe aanmu haeh hanah a caeh: \wj*
\wj aanmu to a haeh naah, thoemto loe loklam taengah krak, tavaanawk angzoh o moe, aanmu to akhui o boih. \wj*
\wj Thoemto loe long kathah ai, kapop thlung nuiah krak; long to tampa pongah, aanmu loe akra ai ah amprawk roep: \wj*
\wj toe ni to bet moe, kabae ni mah dawk naah loe, tangzun om ai pongah, azaem ving. \wj*
\wj Thoemto aanmu loe soekhring thungah krak, soekhring kungnawk loe qoeng o tahang moe, aanmu to tacet o hmoek, to pongah athaih athai ai. \wj*
\wj Kalah aanmu loe long kahoih nuiah krak, a qoeng tahang moe, kapop ah aquih to tacawt; thoemto loe qui thum, thoemto loe qui taruk, thoemto loe cumvai khoek to pung o tahang, \wj* tiah a naa.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Thaihaih naa tawn kami loe, thaih nasoe, \wj* tiah a naa.
Anih angmah bueng oh naah, hatlai hnetto hoi a taengah kaom kaminawk mah patahhaih lok to dueng o.

Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Sithaw mah siangpahrang ah ukhaih prae ih lok tamqu panoek thaihaih to nangcae khaeah paek boeh: toe tasa bangah kaom kaminawk hanah loe, hmuen boih patahhaih hoiah ni thuih: \wj*

\x - \xo 4:12 \xt Isaiah 6.9,10.\x*\wj nihcae loe hnu o tih, toe maat o mak ai; thaih loe thaih o tih, toe panoek o thai mak ai; to tih ai nahaeloe nihcae mah poekhaih amkhraih o ueloe, nihcae zaehaihnawk to tahmen moeng tih, tiah thuih ih lok to oh, \wj* tiah a naa.
To pongah anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Hae patahhaih lok hae na panoek o thai ai maw? Na panoek o thai ai nahaeloe patahhaih hoiah thuih ih loknawk boih to kawbangmaw na panoek o thai tih? \wj*

\wj Lam taengah kaom kaminawk kheah tamthang lok to a haeh, to kaminawk loe tamthanglok to thaih o, toe Setan loe karangah angzoh moe, nihcae palung thungah haeh ih tamthanglok to lak pae ving, tiah thuih koehhaih ih ni. \wj*
\wj Thoemto kaminawk loe kapop thlung ahmuen ah kakrah aanmu hoiah anghmong o; nihcae mah lok to thaih o naah, anghoehaih hoiah talawk o roep; \wj*
\wj toe tangzun om ai pongah, atue setta thung khue ni pauep thaih: tamthang lok pongah raihaih hoi pacaekthlaekhaih oh naah, nihcae loe amtimh o roep. \wj*
\wj Thoemto kaminawk loe soekhring thungah kakrah aanmu hoiah anghmong o; nihcae loe tamthang lok to thaih o, \wj*
\wj toe hae long nui ih hmuen pongah mawnhaih hoi long angraenghaih mah aling pongah, kalah hmuennawk koehhaih to akun naah, tamthang lok to khuk khoep, to pongah athaih athai ai. \wj*

\wj Thoemto kaminawk loe kahoih long nuiah kakrah aanmu hoiah anghmong; nihcae mah tamthang lok to thaih o naah, talawk o moe, athaih to athaih; thoemto loe alet quithum, thoemto loe quitaruk, thoemto loe cumvai khoek to pung o tahang, \wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Hmaithawk patahhaih  
\r (Luka 8.16-18)

\x - \xo 4:21 \xt Mathai 5.15; Luk 11.33.\x*Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Hmaithawk loe takho tlim ah, to tih ai boeh loe iihkhun tlim ah suek han ih maw a sinh o? Hmai paanghaih ahmuen ah na ai maw a suek? \wj*
\x - \xo 4:22 \xt Mathai 10.26; Luk 12.2.\x*\wj To tiah suek naah ni amtueng ai hmuen tidoeh om ai, kangvingh hmuen doeh om ai ah, amtueng phaeng tih. \wj*
\wj Thaihaih naa tawn kami loe, thaih nasoe. \wj*

\x - \xo 4:24 \xt Mathai 7.2; Luk 6.38.\x*\wj Anih mah nihcae khaeah, Na thaih o ih hmuennawk to acoehaih hoiah poek oh: minawk na tahhaih hmuen hoiah ni nang doeh tah toeng tih: kathaih kami nang khaeah, pop aep ah paek tih. \wj*
\x - \xo 4:25 \xt Mathai 13.12; 25.29; Luk 19.26.\x*\wj Katawn kami to pop aep ah paek ueloe: katawn ai kami loe a tawnh ih hmuen doeh la pae kik tih, \wj* tiah a naa.
Anih mah, \wj Sithaw mah siangpahrang ah ukhaih prae loe, kami maeto mah long ah haeh ih aanmu baktiah ni oh; \wj*
\wj aqum ah iih moe, khodai naah angthawk, aanmu loe amprawk moe, qoeng tahang, toe kawbangmaw to tiah oh, tito anih mah panoek ai. \wj*
\wj Angmah koehah long hoiah aquih to tacawt; tadok tacawt tahang hmaloe pacoengah, aquih to tacawt moe, athaih to athaih. \wj*

\x - \xo 4:29 \xt Joel 3.13.\x*\wj Toe cang hmin naah loe, aah han khawt boeh pongah, anih mah cakra hoiah a aah, \wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Antam mu patahhaih  
\r (Mathai 13.31-32, 34; Luka 13.18-19)
Anih mah, Sithaw mah siangpahrang ah ukhaih prae to kawbangah maw kang patuek o han, to tih ai boeh loe tih hmuen hoiah maw a patah o han?
Sithaw mah siangpahrang ah ukhaih prae loe antam mu hoiah anghmong, antam mu loe long ah patit naah, long ih aanmunawk boih pongah kathoeng koek ah oh:
toe amu to haeh moe, amprawk tahang naah loe, phrohnawk boih pongah len kue, anih ih tahlip tlim ah van ih tavaanawk acuk o thai hanah, kalen parai tanghangnawk to tacawt, tiah a naa.
Nihcae mah panoek o thaih pongah, to baktih paroeai patahhaih hoiah lok to a thuih pae.

Patahhaih lok ai ah loe nihcae khaeah lokthui pae ai: angmacae bueng oh o naah loe, a hnukbang kaminawk khaeah hmuennawk boih kamtuengah a thuih pae.   
\s1 Takhi sae dipsak  
\r (Mathai 8.23-27; Luka 8.22-25)
To na ni, duembang phak naah loe, anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Vapui zaeh bangah caeh o si, \wj* tiah a naa.
A hnukbang kaminawk loe pop parai kaminawk khae hoiah tacawt o moe, palong thung kaom Anih to caeh o haih. Kalah kathoeng kae palongnawk doeh anih hoi nawnto sin o.
To naah takhi sae to song moe, palong thungah tuiphu to akunh, to pongah palong loe tui hoiah koi.

Anih loe palong hnuk bangah, luhngoeng maeto anghngoeng moe a iih: a hnukbang kaminawk mah anih to pathawk o, anih khaeah, Patukkung, kang hmaat o han boeh, tiah doeh nang dawncang ai boeh maw? tiah a naa o.
Anih loe angthawk moe, takhi to zoeh, tuipui khaeah, \wj Dii ah loe, anghngai duem ah, \wj* tiah a naa. To naah takhi to dip moe, paroeai monghaih to oh.
Anih mah, \wj Tipongah to tih khoek to na zit o loe, tanghaih na tawn o ai maw? \wj* tiah a naa.
Nihcae loe paroeai zit o moe, Hae kami loe kawbaktih kami maw vai? Takhi hoi tuipui mah doeh a lok to tahngai pae o bae hae, tiah maeto hoi maeto a thuih o.

\s1 Taqawk sae haekhaih  
\r (Mathai 8.28-34; Luka 8.26-39)
Nihcae loe tuipui yaeh, Gadarene prae bangah caeh o.
Anih palong thung hoi tacawt naah, takoh thungah taqawk sae tawn kami maeto loe anih to hnuk hanah taprong hoiah angzoh.
To kami loe taprong ah oh moe, mi mah doeh anih to taoeng o thai ai; sumqui hoiah doeh taoeng o thai ai:
vaihi hoi vaihi anih to sumboeng hoiah thlongthuk o moe, sumqui hoiah taoeng o cadoeh, anih mah sumqui to taprawt pat moe, sumboeng doeh adaem boih: mi mah doeh anih to angam o sak duem thai ai.
To kami loe qum thun, mae nui hoi taprong ah a hangh moe, angmah hoi angmah to thlung kanoe hoiah ang aah.
Toe anih mah kangtla ahmuen hoiah Jesu to hnuk naah, a cawnh moe, anih to bok.
Tha hoiah a hangh moe, Kai hoi nang timaw asaenghaih oh? Jesu, kasang koek Sithaw Capa, Sithaw hmin hoiah tahmenhaih kang hnik, na pacaekthlaek hmah, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Nang kaciim ai taqawk sae, kami takoh thung hoi tacawt ah, \wj* tiah a naa.
Anih mah to kami khaeah, \wj Na hmin loe mi aa? \wj* tiah a dueng; to kami mah, Kaicae loe ka pop o parai pongah, ka hmin loe legion, tiah pathim pae.
Nihcae to prae kangthla ah patoeh ving han ai ah, to kami mah Jesu khaeah tahmenhaih hnik pae khruek.
Taqawknawk mah Anih khaeah, Ok takoh thungah ka kun o hanah, na patoeh halat ah, tiah tahmenhaih a hnik o.

Jesu mah nihcae to tacawtsak roep. Kaciim ai taqawknawk loe tacawt o moe, ok thungah akun o: oknawk loe tuipui bangah cawnh o tathuk moe, (to oknawk loe sang hnetto phak duih;) tuipui thungah uem o boih.
Ok pacah kaminawk loe vangpui hoi vangta bangah cawnh o moe, to ah kaom hmuen kawng to a thuih pae o. Paroeai kaminawk loe to ah kaom hmuen to khet hanah caeh o.
Jesu khae phak o naah, taqawk mah naeh ih legion tawn kami loe, khukbuen to angkhuk moe, palungha ta hoiah anghnut, anih to hnuk o naah, a zit o.
Taqawk mah naeh ih kami hoi ok nuiah kaom hmuen hnu kaminawk mah kaminawk khaeah thuih pae o patoeng.
To pacoengah nihcae mah to prae to tacawt taak hanah, Anih khaeah tahmenhaih hnik o.
Anih palong thungah akun tom naah, taqawk mah naeh ih kami mah Anih hnukah bang hanah tahmenhaih hnik.

Toe Jesu mah bangsak ai, to kami khaeah, \wj Nam puinawk khaeah, im ah caeh ah loe, Angraeng mah na nuiah, kawkrukmaw tahmenhaih tawnh moe, kalen parai hmuennawk to ang sak pae, tito thui ah, \wj* tiah a naa.

Anih loe caeh moe, Jesu mah kawkruk kalen hmuen maw anih hanah sak pae, tito Dekapolis ah a thuih: to naah kaminawk boih mah dawnrai o.   
\s1 Jairu canu pathawkhaih  
\r (Mathai 9.18-26; Luka 8.40-56)
Jesu loe palong hoiah tuipui yaeh ah caeh moe, tuipui taengah oh, to naah paroeai kaminawk anih khaeah amkhueng o:
khenah, Jairu, tiah ahmin kaom, Sineko ukkung maeto angzoh; anih mah Jesu to hnuk naah, a khokkung ah tabok,
tahmenhaih a hnik, Ka canu ta loe duek tom boeh: tahmenhaih hoi angzo ah loe, a nuiah ban koeng pae rae ah, to tih nahaeloe anih to ngantui thai ueloe, hing tih, tiah a naa.
To pongah Jesu loe anih hoi nawnto caeh; paroeai kaminawk loe ang-et hoiah anih hnukah bang o.
To naah saning hatlai hnetto athii kalong, nongpata maeto oh,
anih loe pop parai tuisi kop kaminawk khaeah caeh boeh moe, a tawnh ih phoisanawk doeh patoh boih boeh, toe hoikhang ai, a nung aep,
to nongpata mah Jesu kawng to thaih naah, pop parai kaminawk salak hoiah anih hnukah caeh moe, anih ih kahni to sui.
Anih ih kahni to ka sui nahaeloe, ngan ka tui tih, tiah a poek.
To naah kalong athii to khap roep; a nathaih hoih boih boeh, tiah a takpum ah panoekhaih to tawnh roep.
Jesu mah a takpum thung hoiah sakthaihaih tacawt boeh, tiah panoek roep naah, pop parai kaminawk khaeah angqoi moe, \wj mi maw kai ih kahni kasui? \wj* tiah a dueng.
A hnukbang kaminawk mah anih khaeah, Pop parai kaminawk mah ang et o, tito na panoek to mah, Kai sui kami loe mi maw? tiah na thuih, tiah a naa o.
Anih mah to tiah kasui nongpata to panoek hanah angqoi moe, a khet khing.
To nongpata mah a nuiah kaom hmuen to panoek naah, a zit moe, tasoeh takuenhaih hoiah anih khokkung ah tabok pacoengah, kaom tangtang hmuennawk to a thuih pae boih.
Jesu mah nongpata khaeah, \wj Ka canu na tanghaih mah ang hoisak boeh; kamongta ah caeh ah, na nathaih to hoih lai nasoe, \wj* tiah a naa.
To tiah anih mah lokthuih li naah, Sineko ukkung Jairu ih im hoiah thoemto kaminawk loe angzoh o moe, Na canu loe duek boeh: tih hanah Patukkung to raihaih na paek khing loe? tiah a naa o.
Jesu mah to lok to thaih naah, anih mah Sineko ukkung khaeah, \wj Zii hmah, \wj* tanghaih khue mah tawn ah, tiah a naa.
Anih mah mi kawbaktih doeh a hnukah bangsak ai, Piter, Jakob hoi Jakob amnawk Johan khue to a kawk.
Sineko ukkung im ah a phak o naah loe, palungset hoi kaqah pop parai kaminawk to a hnuk.
Anih loe imthung ah akun, nihcae khaeah, \wj Tikhoe hae tiah palungset hoiah na qah o loe? Nawkta loe dueh ai, iih ni a iih, \wj* tiah a naa.

To naah nihcae mah anih to pahnui o thuih. Anih mah to ah kaom kaminawk to tasa bangah tacawtsak boih moe, nawkta ih amno hoi ampa, angmah hoi nawnto kaom kaminawk to nawkta pasonghaih ahmuen ah a caeh haih.
Nawkta to ban ah sui moe, anih khaeah, \wj Talitha kumi, \wj* tiah a naa; a thuih koehhaih loe, \wj Nawkta ta, angthawk lai ah, \wj* tiah kang naa, tih haih ih ni.
Akra ai ah nongpata ta loe angthawk moe, lam a caeh; nongpata loe saning hatlai hnetto oh boeh. To ah kaom kaminawk loe paroeai dawnrai o.
Anih mah to ah kaom kaminawk khaeah minawk panoek o sak hmah, tiah acoehaih a paek; to pacoengah \wj nongpata ta hanah caaknaek to paek oh, \wj* tiah a naa.

\s1 Nazareth ah Jesu tapom o ai  
\r (Mathai 13.53-58; Luka 4.16-30)
Anih loe hae ahmuen hoiah tacawt moe, angmah vang bangah a caeh; a hnukbang kaminawk loe anih hnukah caeh o.

Sabbath ni phak naah loe, anih mah Sineko thungah kaminawk to patuk: anih mah patuk ih lok thaih paroeai kaminawk loe dawnrai o, Hae kami loe naa hoi ih maw hae baktih hmuennawk hae a hnuk? Naa ih palunghahaih maw a hnuk moe, to baktih dawnrai hmuennawk to a sak?

Hae kami loe thing toksah kami na ai maw? Meri capa, Jakob, Jose, Judah hoi Simon ih amya na ai maw? A tanuhnawk doeh aicae khaeah oh o na ai maw? tiah a thuih o. Nihcae mah anih to palungphui o thuih.
\x - \xo 6:4 \xt Jhn 4.44.\x*Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Tahmaa loe angmah prae, angmah acaeng hoi angmah imthung takoh tasa bangah ni pakoehhaih to hnuk, \wj* tiah a naa.
Ngantui ai kami zetta nuiah ban to a koeng moe, ngantuisak khue ai ah loe, anih mah to ahmuen ah dawnrai koi kaom hmuen to sah thai ai.

Nihcae tanghaih tawn o ai pongah, anih loe dawnrai. Anih loe a taengah kaom avangnawk ah caeh moe, kaminawk to patuk.   
\s1 Hatlai hnettonawk patoehhaih
Anih mah kami hatlai hnettonawk angmah khaeah kawk, kami long hnetto amyoksak moe, patoeh; nihcae khaeah kaciim ai taqawk sae haek thaihaih to a paek.
Kholong a caeh o naah, cunghet khue ai ah loe, takaw, pasah, phoisa tabu thungah tangka to sin o hmah;
toe khokpanai loe abuen oh, laihaw kathah hnetto sin o hmah, tiah a naa.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Im maeto ah na kun o naah, to avang na tacawt o taak ai karoek to to im ah om oh. \wj*

\x - \xo 6:11 \xt Tsk 13.51.\x*\x - \xo 6:11 \xt Luk 10.4-11.\x*\wj Mi kawbaktih doeh nangcae talawk ai, lok tahngai ai kami loe, to ahmuen hoi na tacawt o naah, nihcae koeh ai ih amtuengsak hanah, nangmacae khokpadae ih maiphu to takhoek oh. Loktang kang thuih o, Lokcaekhaih niah to vangpui loe, Sodom hoi Komorah pongah kamtlai ah raihaih tong o tih, \wj* tiah a naa.
Kaminawk mah zaehaih dawnpakhuem o thai hanah, nihcae loe caeh o moe, lok to taphong o.

\x - \xo 6:13 \xt Jkb 5.14.\x*Pop parai taqawknawk to nihcae mah haek o, nganna paroeai kaminawk to situi bawh o moe, ngantui o sak.   
\s1 Johan duekhaih  
\r (Mathai 14.1-12: Luka 9.7-9)

\x - \xo 6:14 \xt Mathai 16.14; Mark 8.28; Luk 9.19.\x*(Anih ih ahmin to amthang pongah,) Herod siangpahrang mah thaih: to naah anih mah, Tuinuemhaih paekkung Johan loe duekhaih thung hoiah angthawk let boeh, to pongah ni anih khaeah dawnrai hmuen to amtueng, tiah thuih.
Thoemto kaminawk mah loe, Elijah ni, tiah thuih o. Thoemto kaminawk mah loe, Anih loe tahmaa maeto maw, to tih ai boeh loe canghnii ih tahmaanawk thungah kaom tahmaa maeto ah oh, tiah a thuih o.
Toe Herod mah thaih naah, Kai mah tahnong takroek ih Johan ni, duekhaih thung hoiah angthawk let boeh, tiah a thuih.
\x - \xo 6:17 \xt Luk 3.19,20.\x*Herod loe amnawk Philip ih zu, Herodias to zu ah a lak, to kawng pongah angmah khaeh mah Johan to naehsak moe, taoengh pacoengah, thongim thungah pakhrak.
Johan mah Herod khaeah, Daan ai ah nam nawk ih zu to na lomh pae, tiah a naa.
To pongah Herodias mah Johan to hnukma, anih to hum hanah koeh; toe anih mah hum thai ai:

Herod mah Johan loe toeng moe, kaciim kami ah oh, tito panoek, to pongah Johan to zit moe, anih to a khetzawn; Johan mah sak ih paroeai hmuennawk to Herod mah thaih, toe anih ih lok to oephaih hoiah tahngaih pae.
Atue karaem phak naah, Herod mah angmah tapenhaih niah angmah ih angraengnawk, misatuh angraengnawk hoi Kalili prae ukkungnawk hanah, buh raenghaih poih to a sak pae;

to naah Herodias ih canu to angzoh moe, a hnawh, Herod hoi a taengah anghnu kaminawk to poek nawmsak, to naah siangpahrang mah nongpata khaeah, na koeh ih hmuen kawbaktih doeh na hni ah, kang paek han, tiah a naa.
Anih mah nongpata ta khaeah, Kawbaktih hmuen doeh nang hnik nahaeloe, to hmuen to kang paek han, ka prae ahap mataeng doeh kang paek han, tiah lokkamhaih to a sak.
To naah nongpata mah amno khaeah caeh moe, Timaw ka hnik han, tiah a naa. To naah Amno mah, tuinuemhaih paekkung Johan ih lu to hni ah, tiah a naa.
Nongpata loe siangpahrang khaeah karangah caeh moe, Tuinuemhaih paekkung Johan ih lu to sabae nuiah vaihi nang paek hanah ka koeh, tiah a naa.
Siangpahrang loe palungset parai; toe angmah hoi kaom kaminawk hma ah, lokkamhaih a sak boeh pongah, nongpata mah hnik ih hmuen to aek pae ai.
Siangpahrang mah kami humkung to karangah patoeh moe, Johan ih lu to sin hanah lok a paek: to kami loe thongim thungah caeh moe, Johan ih tahnong to takroek pacoengah,
anih ih lu to sabae nuiah a sin moe, nongpata hanah paek: nongpata mah amno khaeah paek.

To lok to a hnukbang kaminawk mah thaih o naah, angzoh o moe, anih ih qok to lak o pacoengah, aphum o.   
\s1 Kami sang pangato pacah  
\r (Mathai 14.13-21; Luka 9.10-17; Johan 6.1-1)
Patoeh ih kaminawk Jesu khaeah amkhueng o moe, a sak o ih hmuennawk hoi anih mah patuk o ih hmuennawk boih anih khaeah thuih pae o.

\wj Angzo kami hoi amlaem kami paroeai pop pongah, buhcaakhaih atue mataeng doeh tawn o ai, to pongah anih mah a hnukbang kaminawk khaeah, Nangmacae bueng ka hnukah angzo o ah, kami amdingruehaih ahmuen ah nawnetta thung anghak o rae si, \wj* tiah a naa.
Nihcae caeh o boeh, tito pop parai kaminawk mah panoek o, anih to hnuk o naah, avang thung ih kaminawk boih khok hoiah cawnh o, nihcae hma ah phak o hmaloe moe, anih khaeah nawnto amkhueng o.

\x - \xo 6:34 \xt NAM 27.17; 1 Siang 22.17; 2 Dung 18.16; Ezek 34.5; Mathai 9.36.\x*Jesu to ah phak naah pop parai kaminawk to hnuk, nihcae loe toepkung tawn ai tuunawk baktiah oh o pongah, nihcae nuiah paroeai tahmenhaih a tawnh: anih mah to kaminawk hanah paroeai hmuen kawng to patuk pae.
Niduem naah a hnukbang kaminawk anih khaeah angzoh o moe, Hae ahmuen loe praezaek ah oh moe, kho doeh ving boeh:
nihcae to caehsak lai ah, nihcae loe caak han tidoeh tawn o ai pongah, a taengah kaom avangnawk ah a caeh o moe, angmacae caak hanah takaw a qan o han oh, tiah a thuih pae o.

Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Nihcae caak hanah buh paek o khae, \wj* tiah a naa. To naah nihcae mah anih khaeah, Ka caeh o moe, cumvai hnetto atho takaw qan pacoengah, nihcae caak hanah ka paek o han maw? tiah a naa o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Takaw nazetto maw na tawnh o? Caeh oh loe khen oh, \wj* tiah a naa. Nihcae mah khet o pacoengah, takaw kae pangato hoi tanga hnetto oh, tiah a naa o.
To naah anih mah nihcae khaeah pop parai kaminawk to phroh kahing nuiah abu abu ah anghnut hanah a hnukbang kaminawk to thuisak.
To tiah kaminawk to cumvaito, quipangato ah anghnut o sak.

Anih mah takaw kae pangato hoi tanga hnetto to a lak, van bangah a doeng tahang moe, tahamhoihaih paek pacoengah, takaw to a aeh, kaminawk pazet hanah a hnukbang kaminawk to a paek; tanga hnetto doeh nihcae boih hanah pazetsak.
Nihcae loe caak o moe, zok amhah o boih.
Kamtlai takaw hoi tanga caaknoi to a phrom o naah, benthang hatlai hnetto koi.

To ih buhcaa kaminawk loe sang pangato phak duih.   
\s1 Jesu tui nuiah caeh  
\r (Mathai 14.22-23; Johan 6.15-21)
Jesu mah a hnukbang kaminawk palong thungah akunsak roep moe, Bethsaida avang bangah caeh o hmaloe hanah patoeh.
Nihcae patoeh pacoengah, lawkthuih hanah mae nuiah a caeh.
Duembang phak naah, palong loe tuipui um ah oh, anih loe angmah bueng tuicing ah oh.

Nihcae bangah takhi song pongah, a hnukbang kaminawk palong mong o thai ai, tito a hnuk: qum atue khethaih palito phak tom naah, nihcae ohhaih ahmuen ah tuipui nuiah a caeh moe, nihcae khaeah phak duih boeh.
Tuipui nuiah kacaeh Anih to a hnukbang kaminawk mah hnuk o naah, pakhra mue, tiah a poek o pongah a hangh o:
nihcae boih mah Anih to hnuk o naah, angpae o. Akra ai ah nihcae khaeah, \wj Kamongah om oh: Kai ni; zii o hmah, \wj* tiah a naa.
To pacoengah palong nuiah nihcae khaeah a dawh tahang; to naah takhi to dip: nihcae loe thui laek ai khoek to dawnrai o.
Nihcae loe palungthah o pongah, takaw kawng pongah a sak ih dawnrai hmuen to panoek o ai boeh.
Nihcae loe tuipui yaeh ah caeh o, Genesaret prae thungah akun o moe, to ah anghak o.
Palong thung hoi anghum o naah, to ahmuen ah kaom kaminawk mah anih to maat o.
To prae thung ih kaminawk boih cawnh o moe, a thaih o ih Anih ohhaih ahmuen ah nganna kaminawk to phak hoiah angzawn o.

Vangta ah maw, to tih ai boeh loe vangpui ah maw, to tih ai boeh loe prae thungah maw, Anih caehhaih ahmuen kruekah nganna kaminawk to loklam ah a suek o moe, Anih ih kahni atom to sui duem han ih Anih khaeah tahmenhaih hnik o: sui kaminawk loe ngantuihaih hnuk o boih.

\s1 Kami amhnonghaih  
\r (Mathai 15.1-9)
Jerusalem hoiah angzo ca tarik thoemto kaminawk hoi Farasinawk Jesu khaeah amkhueng o.
To naah a hnukbang kaminawk loe kaciim ah buhcaa o ai, tiah nihcae mah hnuk o (thuih koehhaih loe ban amsae ai ah buh caak o pongah kasae ah a hnuk o).
Farasinawk hoi Judahnawk boih loe ban amsae ai ah, buh caa o ai, saning coeh kaminawk loe khosak kangquem to patawn o caeng vop.

Hmuenmae zawhhaih ahmuen ih hmuennawk cae loe pasae ai ah loe caa o ai. Boengloeng, laom sabaenawk, khaang laomnawk hoi caboinawk to pasaeh khue khawt ai, kalah atawknawk doeh kacakah patawnh o moe, pazui o.
Topongah Farasinawk hoi ca tarik kaminawk mah, tipongah nang hnukbang kaminawk loe kacoehtanawk mah thuih ih lok to pazui o ai moe, ban amsae ai ah buh a caak o loe? tiah lok a dueng o.

\x - \xo 7:6 \xt Isaiah 29.13.\x*Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Isaiah mah nangcae angsah thaih kami kawng tarik ih oh, Hae kaminawk loe pakha hoiah kai ang saphaw o, toe nihcae ih palungthin loe kai khae hoi angthla o. \wj*
\wj Atho kaom ai anui aphawn hoiah kai ang bok o moe, kaminawk mah sak ih loknawk to ni patuk o, tiah thuih. \wj*

\wj Sithaw mah paek ih loknawk to na vah o moe, kaminawk ih atawk mah, boengloeng hoi laom sabaenawk pasaeh han angaih, tiah patuk ih kaminawk ih atawk hoi kalah hmuennawk to kacakah na patawnh o lat, \wj* tiah a naa.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Nangmacae khosakhaih atawk to na pazui o thai hanah, Sithaw ih kaalok to na vah o ving. \wj*

\x - \xo 7:10 \xt EXO 20.12; Deu 5.16; \xt EXO 21.17; LEV 20.9.\x*\wj Mosi mah, Nam no hoi nam pa to saiqat ah; mi kawbaktih doeh amno maw, to tih ai boeh loe ampa maw kasae thui kami loe, paduek han oh, tiah thuih: \wj*

\wj toe nangcae mah loe, Mi kawbaktih doeh amno maw, to tih ai boeh loe ampa khaeah maw, Kai khae hoi atho hnuk han koi kaom hmuennawk boih loe Korban ah ni oh, \wj* (to hmuen loe tangqum tiah thuih koehhaih ih ni,) \wj tiah thui nahaeloe, anih loe loih boeh. \wj*
\wj Anih mah amno hoi ampa khetzawn han angaih ai boeh, tiah na thuih pae o; \wj*
\wj to tiah nangmacae ih khosak kangquem hoiah Sithaw ih lok atho kaom ai ah na sak o: hae baktih kalah pop parai hmuennawk doeh na sak o vop, \wj* tiah a naa.
Anih mah paroeai kaminawk to angmah khaeah kawk moe, nihcae khaeah, \wj nangcae boih mah tahngai oh loe, thaikophaih to tawn oh: \wj*
\wj tasa bang hoi kami takpum thungah akun, kami amhnongsak thaih hmuen tidoeh om ai: toe kami takpum thung hoi tacawt hmuen mah ni kami to amhnongsak. \wj*
\wj Mi kawbaktih doeh thaihaih naa tawn kami loe, thai nasoe, \wj* tiah a naa.
Pop parai kaminawk to a caehtaak moe, imthung ah akun pacoengah, a hnukbang kaminawk mah patahhaih lok to dueng o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Nangcae doeh na thaih o kop ai maw? Tasa bang hoi kami takpum thungah akun kawbaktih hmuen mah doeh, kami to amhnongsak thai ai, tito na panoek o ai maw? \wj*
\wj To hmuen loe kami palung thungah akun ai, zok thungah ni akunh, zok thung ih caaknaeknawk to ciimsak pacoengah, aek ah tacawt, \wj* tiah a naa.
Anih mah, \wj Kami takoh thung hoi angzo hmuen mah ni, kami to amhnongsak thaih. \wj*
\wj A thung hoiah loe kasae poekhaih, zu sava laep ah zae sakhaih, daan ai ah nongpa nongpata zae sakhaih, kami humhaih, \wj*
\wj paqukhaih, uthaih, poeksethaih, alinghaih, zae sak koehhaih, khithaih, loksae thuihaih, amoekhaih, amthuhaih: \wj*

\wj hae kasae hmuennawk boih loe kami takoh thung hoiah angzoh moe, kami to amhnongsak, \wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Nongpata tanghaih kalen  
\r (Mathai 15.21-28)
Anih loe to ahmuen hoiah angthawk moe, Tura hoi Sidon prae bangah a caeh, minawk mah panoek han ai ah, im maeto thungah akun, toe anih loe anghawk thai ai.
Taqawk sae tawn nongpata ih amno mah anih angzohhaih tamthang to thaih naah, anih khaeah angzoh moe, a hma ah cangkrawn pae:
to nongpata loe Syrophonicia prae ah kaom Grik kami ah oh; a canu ih takoh thung hoiah taqawk haek pae hanah, anih khaeah tahmenhaih a hnik.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Nawktanawk zok kamhah ah caa o rae nasoe: nawktanawk ih buh to lak pae ving moe, uinawk khaeah paek han hoih ai, \wj* tiah a naa.
To nongpata mah, Ue, Angraeng; toe uinawk mah loe caboi tlim ah kakrah nawktanawk ih caaknoi to a caak o bae, tiah a naa.
To tiah thuih ih lok pongah, \wj Anih mah nongpata khaeah caeh lai ah; taqawk sae loe na canu takoh thung hoi tacawt boeh, \wj* tiah a naa.

To nongpata loe angmah im ah amlaem, to naah a canu takoh thung hoiah taqawk to tacawt boeh moe, iihkhun nuiah ka-iip a canu to a hnuk.   
\s1 Naapang hoisak
Tura hoi Sidon vangpui to tacawt taak moe, Dekapolis prae thung hoiah Kalili tuipui bangah a caeh.
To ahmuen ah naa pangh moe, lok doeh ka-aa kami maeto, anih khaeah hoih o; a nuiah ban koeng pae hanah tahmenhaih a hnik pae o.
Anih mah to kami to pop parai kaminawk salak hoiah ahmuen kalah bangah caeh haih, anih ih naa khaw to ban pazung hoiah tapawh pae, tamtui pathoih pae moe, palai to a sui pae;
van bangah doeng tahang moe, kasawkah anghah pacoengah, \wj Eph-phatha, \wj* tiah a thuih, thuih koehhaih loe, Am-ong lai ah, tih haih ih ni.
Akra ai ah to kami ih naa to amongh pae moe, palai thaqui doeh naem pae boeh pongah, kahoihah lok apaeh thai roep.
Mi khaeah doeh thui hmah, tiah a naa: toe nihcae mah kanung aep ah a thuih o.
To ah kaom kaminawk loe dawnrai o boih, anih loe hmuen boih kahoihah sak: naapang kami to naa amongsak moe, lokaa doeh lok apaehsak, tiah a thuih o.
To na niah kami pop o parai moe, caak han tidoeh tawn o ai, Jesu mah a hnukbang kaminawk to angmah khaeah kawk moe, nihcae khaeah,
\wj hae kaminawk loe tahmen thoh parai, nihcae loe caak han tidoeh tawn ai ah, kai hoi nawnto ni thumto thung oh o boeh: \wj*
\wj nihcae hae zok kamthlam ah im ah ka ptoeh nahaeloe, loklam ah thazok o sut tih: thoemto kaminawk loe angthla parai ahmuen hoiah ni angzoh o, \wj* tiah a naa.
A hnukbang kaminawk mah anih khaeah, Hae praezaek ah hae kaminawk caak khawt takaw naa ah maw a hnu o tih? tiah a naa o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Takaw kae nazetto maw na tawnh o? \wj* tiah a dueng, nihcae mah, Sarihto tiah a naa o.

Anih mah pop parai kaminawk to long ah anghnutsak hanah a thuih pae: takaw kae sarihto a lak moe, anghoehaih lawkthuih pacoengah, a aeh, nihcae to pazet hanah a hnukbang kaminawk khaeah a paek; nihcae mah pop parai kaminawk hma ah patoemh pae o.
A tawnh o ih tanga tetta doeh a lak moe, tahamhoihhaih a paek: kaminawk hma ah patoem pae hanah a thuih pae.
Nihcae mah caak o moe, zok amhah o: caaknoi to nihcae mah phromh o naah benthang sarihto koi.
Buhcaa kaminawk loe sang palito oh duih: to pacoengah anih mah to kaminawk to caehsak.

To pacoengah akra ai ah anih loe a hnukbang kaminawk hoi palong thungah akun o moe, Dalmanutha prae bangah caeh o.   
\s1 Farasinawk mah angmathaih pakrong o
\x - \xo 8:11 \xt Mathai 12.38; Luk 11.16.\x*Farasinawk angzoh o moe, anih khaeah tanoekhaih lok dueng o pacoengah, anih khae hoi van bang ih angmathaih to pakrong o.

\x - \xo 8:12 \xt Mathai 12.39; Luk 11.29.\x*Anih loe kasawkah takhi to hroek moe, nihcae khaeah, \wj Vaihi dung ih kaminawk loe tih pongah maw angmathaih to pakrong o? Loktang kang thuih o, Vaihi dung ih kaminawk khaeah angmathaih tidoeh paek mak ai boeh, \wj* tiah a naa.
Nihcae to a caeh taak, palong thungah akun let moe, tuipui yaeh ah a caeh.
A hnukbang kaminawk loe takaw sin han pahnet o ving, palong thungah angmacae han takaw kae maeto khue ni a tawnh o boeh.
\x - \xo 8:15 \xt Luk 12.1.\x*Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj palungha hoi khosah oh loe, Farasinawk hoi Herod ih taeh hoiah acoe oh, \wj* tiah a naa.
Nihcae mah takaw tawn o ai boeh pongah mue to tiah lok a thuih, tiah poek o.

A poek o haih to Jesu mah panoek pae naah, nihcae khaeah, \wj Tikhoe takaw na sin o ai pongah to tiah lok na thuih o loe? Palung thungah na pakuem o ai moe, na thaih o kop ai vop maw? Vaihi khoek to palung nam tak o sak vop maw? \wj*
\x - \xo 8:18 \xt Jer 5.21; Ezek 12.2; Mark 4.12.\x*\wj Mik na tawnh o to mah, na hnu o ai maw? Naa na tawnh o to mah, na thaih o ai maw? Na panoek o ai boeh maw? \wj*
\wj Kami sang pangato hanah takaw kae pangato ka aeh naah, caaknoi kamtlai benthang nazetto maw na phromh o? \wj* tiah a naa. Nihcae mah anih khaeah, Benthang hatlai hnetto, tiah a naa o.
Kami sang palito hanah takaw kae sarihto ka aeh naah, caaknoi kamtlai nazetto maw na phromh o? tiah a naa. Nihcae mah, benthang sarihto, tiah a naa o.

Anih mah nihcae khaeah, Tipongah na panoek o thai ai loe? tiah a naa.   
\s1 Mikmaeng to hoisak
Anih Bethsaida vangpui ah angzoh o naah; anih khaeah mikmaeng maeto angzoh o haih, mikmaeng to sui hanah anih khaeah tahmenhaih hnik pae o.

Anih mah mikmaeng to ban ah zaeh moe, vangpui tasa bangah caeh haih, anih mah mikmaeng ih mik to tamtui hoiah pathoih pae moe, a nuiah ban koeng pae pacoengah, \wj mikmaeng khaeah hmuen maeto na hnuk thaih maw, \wj* tiah a naa.
Mikmaeng mah khet tahang moe, Thingkungnawk baktiah lam kacaeh, kaminawk to ka hnuk, tiah a naa.
To naah anih mah mikmaeng ih mik nuiah ban to koeng pae let, mikmaeng to van bangah a khetsak: to naah a mik to hoih pae moe, kaminawk to kamtuengah a hnuk.

Anih mah mikmaeng khaeah, \wj Vangpui ah caeh hmah, vangpui ah mi khaeah doeh thui hmah, \wj* tiah thuih pae pacoengah, angmah im bangah patoeh ving.   
\s1 Piter mah Jesu mathaih  
\r (Mathai 16.13-20; Luka 9.18-21)
Jesu loe Caesarea Philipi vangpui ah, a hnukbang kaminawk hoi nawnto caeh o: loklam ah a hnukbang kaminawk khaeah, \wj Minawk mah kai hae kawbangah maw a thuih o? \wj* tiah lok a dueng.

\x - \xo 8:28 \xt Mark 6.14,15; Luk 9.7,8.\x*Nihcae mah, Tuinuem paekkung Johan, tiah pathim pae o; toe thoemto kaminawk mah loe Elijah; kalah kaminawk mah loe tahmaanawk thungah kaom tahmaa maeto ah oh, tiah a thuih o, tiah a naa o.
\x - \xo 8:29 \xt Jhn 6.68,69.\x*Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Nangcae mah loe kai hae kawbaktih kami ah maw na poek o? \wj* tiah a naa. To naah Piter mah anih khaeah, Nang loe Kri ni, tiah a naa.

Anih mah angmah kawng to mi khaeah doeh thuih han ai ah lok a thuih pae.   
\s1 Angzo han koi thuicoekhaih  
\r (Mathai 16.21-28; Luka 9.22-27)
Kami Capa loe paroeai patangkhang tih, kacoehtanawk, kalen koek qaima hoi ca tarik kaminawk mah pahnawt o ueloe, hum o tih, toe ni thumto pacoengah angthawk let tih, tiah nihcae to patuk amtong.
Angmah kawng to angphat ai ah a thuih. To pongah Piter mah anih to kawk moe, a thuitaek.
Toe anih loe a hnukbang kaminawk khaeah angqoi moe, Piter to a zoeh, \wj Setan, ka hnukah angnawn ah: Sithaw ih hmuen palung thungah na suem ai, kaminawk ih hmuen to na suek lat, \wj* tiah a naa.

\x - \xo 8:34 \xt Mathai 10.38; Luk 14.27.\x*Anih mah kaminawk to a hnukbang kaminawk hoi nawnto angmah khaeah kawk moe, nihcae khaeah, \wj Mi kawbaktih doeh ka hnukah angzoh koeh kami loe, angmah hoi angmah to amhnawt nasoe, angmah ih thinglam to apu nasoe loe, ka hnukah bang nasoe. \wj*

\x - \xo 8:35 \xt Mathai 10.39; Luk 17.33; Jhn 12.25.\x*\wj Mi kawbaktih doeh a hinghaih pahlong kami loe pathlong tih, toe mi kawbaktih doeh Kai hoi tamthanglok hoih pongah a hinghaih pathlong kami loe pahlong ah om tih. \wj*
\wj Kami maeto mah long pum tawn langlacadoeh, a hinghaih to pathlong nahaeloe, timaw avanghaih oh? \wj*
\wj To tih ai boeh loe kami maeto mah a hinghaih to tih hmuen hoiah maw alai thai tih? \wj*

\wj To pongah mi kawbaktih doeh daan ai ah zae sakhaih hoi zae sak koehhaih adung thungah Kai hoi Ka lok azat haih kami loe, kami Capa mah doeh Ampa lensawkhaih hoiah kacai van kaminawk hoi nawnto angzoh naah azat haih toeng tih, \wj* tiah a naa.

Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Loktang kang thuih o, thacakhaih hoiah angzo Sithaw prae hnu o ai karoek to, haeah angdoe thoemto kaminawk thungah duekhaih pataeng han ai kami to oh, \wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Krang amkhraihaih  
\r (Mathai 17.1-2; Luka 9.28-36)
\x - \xo 9:2 \xt 2 Pt 1.17,18.\x*Ni tarukto pacoengah Jesu mah Piter, Jakob hoi Johan to hoih moe, maesang nuiah dawh haih, to ah angmacae bueng oh o: to naah nihcae hma ah krang amkhraih pae.
Anih ih kahni loe ni aengh baktiah ampha; long nuiah kaom tih hmuen mah doeh patah thai ai khoek to dantui kanglung baktiah anglung.
Elijah hoi Mosi doeh nihcae hma ah amtueng pae: nihnik loe Jesu hoiah lok apaeh hoi.
Piter mah Jesu khaeah, Rabbi, aicae loe haeah oh han hoih: buk thumto sah o si; nang hanah maeto, Mosi hanah maeto, Elijah hanah maeto, tiah a naa.
Nihcae loe zit o parai pongah, timaw thuih han, tito panoek o ai.
\x - \xo 9:7 \xt Mathai 3.17; Mark 1.11; Luk 3.22.\x*To naah tamai mah nihcae to khuk khoep; tamai thung hoiah, Hae loe Ka palung duek ih Capa ah oh: a lok tahngai pae oh, tiah lok to angzoh.
Nawnetta oh pacoengah nihcae mah a taeng bangah khet o, to naah angmacae hoi Jesu khue ai ah loe kalah mi doeh hnu o ai.
Nihcae mae nui hoi anghum o tathuk naah, kami Capa duekhaih hoi angthawk ai karoek to a hnuk o ih hmuennawk to mi kawbaktih khaeah doeh thuih han ai ah nihcae han lok a thuih pae.
Nihcae mah to lok to pakuem o, duekhaih hoi angthawk lethaih, tiah thuih ih lok loe tih thuih koehhaih ih maw vai? tiah angmacae hoi angmacae lok angdueng o.
\x - \xo 9:11 \xt Mal 4.5; Mathai 11.14.\x*Nihcae mah anih khaeah, Tipongah ca tarik kaminawk mah loe Elijah angzo hmaloe tih, tiah thuih o loe? tiah a dueng o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Elijah angzo hmaloe ueloe, hmuennawk sah pakhrai boih tih; kami Capa loe paroeai patangkhang ueloe, pahnawt o sut tih, tiah tarik ih lok to oh. \wj*

\wj Toe kang thuih o, angmah kawng tarik ih baktih toengah Elijah loe angzoh boeh, toe nihcae mah a nuiah koeh thaithue hmuen to sak o, \wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Taqawk tawn kami ngantuihaih  
\r (Mathai 17.14-21; Luka 9.37-43)
A hnukbang kaminawk ohhaih ahmuen ah a phak naah, nihcae taengah kaom pop parai kaminawk to a hnuk, ca tarik kaminawk loe nihcae hoi lok angaek o.
Kami boih mah anih to hnuk o naah, dawnrai o moe, anih dawt hanah cawnh o.
Anih mah ca tarik kaminawk khaeah \wj tih lok maw nihcae khaeah na dueng o? \wj* tiah a naa.
To naah paroeai kaminawk thung ih kami maeto mah, Patukkung, taqawk mah naeh ih lokaa, ka capa nang khaeah kang zoh haih;

taqawk mah anih to naeh kruek, long ah amtimh moe, pakha thung hoiah tamtui poep to tacawt, haa a kaek moe, ngan kana baktiah ngan to a zaek pae: taqawk haek pae hanah na hnukbang kaminawk khaeah ka thuih pae, toe nihcae mah haek o thai ai, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah to kami khaeah, \wj Tanghaih tawn ai kaminawk, nasetto maw nangcae khaeah ka oh moe, nasetto maw kang moek o han vop? Nawkta to kai khaeah na hoi oh, \wj* tiah a naa.
Nawkta to anih khaeah hoih o: taqawk mah Anih to hnuk naah, nawkta loe long ah amtimh; pakha hoi tamtui poep to tacawt moe, long ah amlet.
Anih mah nawkta ih ampa khaeah, \wj Saning nazetto maw hae tiah oh boeh, tiah a dueng. Ampa mah nawkta nathuem hoiah oh boeh, \wj* tiah a naa.
Anih to paduek hanah hmai thungah doeh, tui thungah doeh, vaihi hoi vaihi a vah: toe na sak thaih nahaeloe tahmenhaih hoiah na bomh ah, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Na tang thaih nahaeloe, tang kami hanah hmuennawk boih angcoeng thaih, \wj* tiah a naa.
Nawkta ih ampa mah, Angraeng, ka tang hmang, tang ai ah ka oh han ai ah na bom ah, tiah mikkhraetui hoiah a lok to pathim pae phrat.

To hmuen khet hanah nawnto kacawn kaminawk Jesu mah hnuk naah, Taqawk sae to a zoeh, anih khaeah, \wj Naa pangsak moe, lok aasak taqawk, lok kang paek, nawkta takoh thung hoiah tacawt ah loe, natuek naah doeh akun let hmah lai ah, \wj* tiah a naa.
Taqawk loe hangh moe, nawkta to asoek pacoengah, anih thung hoiah tacawt: nawkta loe kadueh baktiah oh sut; kaminawk mah loe a duek boeh, tiah poek o.
Toe Jesu mah anih to ban ah patawnh moe, pathawk tahang; to naah nawkta loe angdoet tahang.
Anih imthung ah akun naah, a hnukbang kaminawk mah tamquta hoiah tipongah kaicae mah loe ka haek o thai ai loe? tiah a dueng o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Hae baktih hmuen loe lawkthuihaih hoi buhzah haih ai ah loe tacawt thai ai, \wj* tiah a naa.
To ahmuen hoiah tacawt o moe, Kalili prae thungah caeh o; anih mah to tiah kaom hmuen to minawk panoeksak han koeh ai.
A hnukbang kaminawk to hae tiah patuk, nihcae khaeah, Kami Capa to minawk ban ah paek o ueloe, anih to hum o tih; anih loe hum o pacoeng, ni thumto naah angthawk let tih, tiah a naa.

Toe anih thuih koehhaih to nihcae mah panoek o thai ai, dueng hanah doeh zit o.   
\s1 Hnukbang kami tangtang

\x - \xo 14:27 \xt Zek 13.7.\x*Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Tuutoep kami to ka boh han, tuunawk loe anghaeh o phang tih, tiah tarik ih baktih toengah, Kai pongah vaiduem palung na boeng o boih tih. \wj*
\x - \xo 14:28 \xt Mathai 28.16.\x*\wj Toe kang thawk pacoengah, Nangcae hmaa ah Kalili ah ka caeh han,\wj* tiah a naa.
Piter mah anih khaeah, Minawk palung boeng o boih cadoeh, kai loe palung ka boeng mak ai, tiah a naa.
Jesu mah, \wj Loktang kang thuih o, Vaihniah, vaiduem roe ah, aa vai hnetto khong ai naah, kai vai thumto nang phat taak tih,\wj* tiah a naa.

Toe Piter mah kanung aep ah, Nang hoi nawnto duek han om cadoeh, nang to kang phat taak mak ai, tiah a naa. Nihcae boih mah doeh to tiah a naa o.   
\s1 Gethsemane ah Jesu pauephaih  
\r (Mathai 26.36-46; Luka 22.39-46)
To pacoengah nihcae loe Gethsemane, tiah ahmin kaom ahmuen ah caeh o: to naah anih mah a hnukbang kaminawk Khaeah, \wj Lawk ka thuih nathung, haeah anghnu oh,\wj* tiah a naa.
Piter, Jakob hoi Johan to angmah khaeah a hoih, angmah loe dawnraihaih, tasoeh takuenhaih hoiah oh;
nihcae khaeah, \wj Ka hinghaih pakhra loe duek han khoek to palungset: haeah om oh loe, na zing oh,\wj* tiah a naa.
Anih loe ahmuen kangthla kue ah caeh moe, angcoeng thai nahaeloe, atue mah Anih to laem taak hanah, long ah cangkrawn hoiah lawk a thuih.

Anih mah, \wj Abba, Pa, nang hanah hmuennawk boih angcoeng thaih; hae boengloeng hae kai khae hoiah takhoe ving ah: toe ka koehhaih baktih na ai ah, na koehhaih baktiah om nasoe,\wj* tiah lawk a thuih.
Anih angzoh naah, ka-iip nihcae to a hnuk, Piter khaeah, \wj Simon, na iih maw? Atue maeto thung mataeng doeh na hak thai ai maw? \wj*
\wj Lawkthuihaih hoiah hak oh, to tih ai nahaeloe pacuekhaih thungah na kun o moeng tih, pakhra mah loe koeh, toe takpum loe thazok,\wj* tiah a naa.
Anih angzoh naah, ka-iip nihcae to a hnuk let, (nihcae loe iih kangmue khang o ai), anih ih lok pathim han mataeng doeh koeh o ai.
Anih vai thumto angzoh naah loe, nihcae khaeah, \wj nang song o moe, vaihi khoek to na iih o vop maw? Khawt boeh, atue mah phak boeh; khenah, Kami Capa loe kazae kaminawk ban ah paek boeh. \wj*

\wj Angthawk oh, caeh o si boeh; khenah, kai angphat taak kami loe phak tom boeh, \wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Jesu naehhaih  
\r (Mathai 26.47-56; Luka 22.47-53; Johan 18.3-12)

Anih lawkthuih li naah, akra ai ah kami hatlai hnetto thung ih maeto ah kaom Judah loe, kalen koek qaima, ca tarik kaminawk hoi kacoehtanawk mah patoeh ih sumsen hoi thingboeng sin pop parai kaminawk to angzoh haih.
Anih angphat taak kami mah nihcae hanah angmathaih a sak pae, Ka mok ih kami loe anih boeh ni; naeh oh loe, kahoih ah caeh o haih ah, tiah a naa.
Jesu angzoh naah, Judah loe anih khaeah caeh phrat moe, Rabbi, Rabbi, tiah kawk pacoengah, anih to a mok.
To pacoengah nihcae angzoh o, anih to naeh o moe, a caeh o haih.
Nihcae taengah angdoe kami maeto loe angmah ih sumsen to aphongh moe, kalen koek qaima tamna ih naa to takroek pae pat.
Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Kamqu naeh baktiah, kai naeh han ih maw sumsen hoi thingboeng hoiah nang zoh o? \wj*

\x - \xo 14:49 \xt Luk 19.47; 21.37.\x*\wj Ni thokkruek nangcae hoi nawnto ka oh moe, tempul thungah ka patuk naah mataeng doeh nang naeh o ai bae: toe cabu thung ih loknawk loe akoep han oh,\wj* tiah a naa.
To naah nihcae mah angphat o taak moe, cawn o taak boih.
Puu laihaw angkhuk thendoeng maeto loe anih hnukah bang; to ih kaminawk mah anih to naeh o:

toe anih mah puu laihaw to vah sut moe, bangkrai ah nihcae to a cawn taak ving.   
\s1 Kaiapha hmaa ah Jesu hoih o  
\r (Mathai 26.57-68; Luka 22.54-55; Johan 18.13-14,19-24)
Jesu to kalen koek qaima khaeah hoih o: kalen koek qaima, katoehtanawk hoi ca tarik kaminawk boih nawnto amkhueng o.
Piter loe kalen koek qaima im khongkha thung khoek to, ahmuen kangthla hoiah anih hnukah bang.
Kalen koek qaima hoi rangpui toksah kaminawk boih mah Jesu hum hanah hnukung to pakrong o, toe hnu o ai.
Paroeai kaminawk loe anih hnukung amsawn ah oh o, toe nihcae hnukhaih loe maeto hoi maeto anghmong ai.
Thoemto kaminawk loe angthawk o moe, anih hnukung amsawn ah oh o,
\x - \xo 14:58 \xt Jhn 2.19.\x*ban hoi sak ih hae tempul hae ka phraek moe, ban hoi sak ai ih tempul kalah to ni thumto thungah ka sak han, tiah anih mah thuih ih lok to ka thaih, tiah a thuih o.
Toe nihcae hnukung ah ohhaih loe maeto hoi maeto anghmong ai.
Kalen koek qaihma loe rangpui hma ah angdoet moe, Jesu to lok a dueng, Tih lok doeh nang pathim mak ai maw? Hae kaminawk mah timaw ang net o? tiah a naa.
Toe anih mah tih lok doeh pathim pae ai, angam taak duem. Kalen koek qaima mah anih khaeah, Nang loe Tahamhoih Capa, Kri maw? tiah a dueng let bae.
\x - \xo 14:62 \xt Dan 7.13.\x*Jesu mah, \wj Ue: Van ih tamai nuiah angzo, thacakhaih hoi bantang bangah anghnu, Kami Capa to na hnu o tih,\wj* tiah a naa.
To naah kalen koek qaima mah angmah ih kahni to asih moe, Aicae mah kalah hnukung timaw angaihaih oh vop?
\x - \xo 14:64 \xt LEV 24.16.\x*Sithaw kasae thuihaih lok na thaih o boeh: kawbangmaw na poek o? tiah a naa. Nihcae boih mah anih to hum hanah lokcaek o.

Thoemto kaminawk mah anih to tamtui hoiah pathoih o, mikhmai khuk pae o khoep moe, thong o, anih khaeah, thui ah, tiah a naa o: tamnanawk mah doeh anih to tabaeng o.   
\s1 Piter mah Jesu angphat taak  
\r (Mathai 26.69-75; Luka 22.56-62; Johan 18.15-18,25-26)
Piter im khongkha tlim ah oh naah, kalen koek qaima ih tamna nongpata maeto angzoh:
hmai kangaw Piter to anih mah hnuk naah, nongpata mah anih to khet moe, Nang doeh Nazareth Jesu hoi nawnto kaom kami na ai maw? tiah a naa.
Toe anih mah angphat taak, Na thuih ih lok to ka panoek ai, ka thaih kop ai, tiah a naa. To pacoengah im hmabang ah a caeh; to naah aa to khong.
Tamna nongpata maeto mah anih to hnuk let bae, a taengah angdoe kaminawk khaeah, Hae kami loe nihcae thung ih kami maeto ah oh, tiah a naa.

To naah anih mah angphat taak let bae. Akra ai ah to ah angdoe kaminawk mah Piter khaeah, tangtang ni nang loe nihcae thung ih kami maeto ah ni na oh: nang loe Kalili kami maeto ah na oh, tito na paeh ih lok pongah amnoek boeh, tiah naa o.
Toe anih mah kasae lokkamhaih hoiah na thuih ih hae Kami loe ka panoek ai, tiah a naa.

To naah vai hnetto haih aa to khong. To naah Piter mah Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj aa vai hnetto khong ai naah vai thumto kai nang phat taak tih,\wj* tiah thuih pae ih lok to poek vawk. To lok to a poek naah palungset moe, a qah.

\s1 Pilat hmaa ah Jesu hoih o  
\r (Mathai 27.1-2,11-14; Luka 23.1-5; Johan 18.28-38)
Akhawnbang khawnthaw ah loe, kalen koek qaima, kacoehtanawk, ca tarik kaminawk hoi lokcaekkungnawk lok aram o, Jesu to pathlet o, anih to hoih o moe, Pilat khaeah thak o.
Pilat mak anih khaeah, Nang loe Judahnawk ih Siangpahrang maw? tiah dueng. Anih mah Pilat khaeah, \wj Na thuih ih baktiah ka oh,\wj* tiah pathim pae.
Kalen koek qaima mah anih nuiah pop parai zae nethaih to tawnh: toe anih mah tidoeh pathim pae ai.
Pilat mah anih to lokdueng let, Tih lok doeh na pathim ai maw? Khenah nang zaehaih net kami nazetto maw oh o! tiah a naa.
Misong loihaih ni phak naah loe, kaminawk mah loisak koeh ih thongim krah kami maeto loisakhaih atawk to oh.
To naah kami hum Barabba, tiah ahmin kaom maeto loe mingcah angmah ampuinawk hoiah nawnto thongkrak; nihcae loe misa angthawk o moe, kami to hum o.
Pop parai kaminawk loe sakzong ih baktih toengah Pilat mah nihcae koehhaih sak pae hanah a hnik o.
Toe Pilat mah nihcae khaeah, Judah Siangpahrang kang prawt pae hanah na koeh o maw? tiah a naa.
Kalen koek qaima mah ut pongah ni Jesu to anih khaeah paek, tito Pilat mah panoek.
Toe Pilat mah Barabba prawt thaih han ai ah, qaima mah kaminawk to pacuek.
Pilat mah nihcae khaeah, to tih nahaeloe Judah Siangpahrang, tiah na kawk o ih kami loe kawbangmaw ka sak han? tiah a naa let.
Nihcae mah, Anih to thinglam pong takhing ah, tiah hang o let.
Pilat mah nihcae khaeah, Tipongah, tih zaehaih maw a sak loe? tiah a naa. Nihcae mah kanung aep ah, Anih to thinglam pong takhing ah, tiah hang o.

Pilat mah palungphui kaminawk dipsak han koeh pongah, Barabba to nihcae khaeah prawt pae, Jesu to a boh pacoengah, thinglam pong takhing hanah nihcae khaeah a paek.   
\s1 Jesu soekhring lumuek angmuek o sak  
\r (Mathai 27.27-31; Johan 19.2-3)
Misatuh kaminawk mah anih to praetorium, tiah kawk ih impui thungah caeh o haih; misatuh kaminawk boih nawnto angcuu o.
Anih to kahni kamling angkhuk o sak, soekhring lumuek to sak pae o moe, anih ih lu ah angmuek o sak.
Nang loe Judah Siangpahrang, tiah a naa o.
A lu ah cung hoi boh o pacoengah, anih to tamtui hoiah pathoih o, ahma ah khokkhu cangkrawn o moe, anih to a bok o.

Nihcae mah pahnui o thuih pacoengah, kahni kamling to khring pae o, angmah ih kahni to angkhuk o sak pacoengah, anih to thinglam pong takhing hanah caeh o haih.   
\s1 Jesu takhing o  
\r (Mathai 27.32-44; Luka 23.26-43; Johan 19.17-27)
\x - \xo 15:21 \xt Rom 16.13.\x*Alexander hoi Rufus ih ampa, Cyrene prae kami Simon loe, lawk hoiah angzoh, loklam ah a caeh li naah, anih to thinglam aput o sak nganga.
Anih to Golgotha, tiah kawk ih ahmuen ah caeh o haih, to ahmuen loe, Lu huh ahmuen, tih thuih koehhaih ih ni.
Nihcae mah anih to myrrh hoi atok ih misurtui to paek o: toe anih mah nae pae ai.
\x - \xo 15:24 \xt Saam 22.18.\x*Nihcae mah anih to thinglam pong takhing o pacoengah, a lak o hanah taham khethaih to sak o pacoengah, anih ih kahni to amzet o.
Atue thumto naah anih to takhing o.
Zae nethaih ca to JUDAH SIANGPAHRANG, tiah a nuiah tarik pae o.
\x - \xo 15:27 \xt Isaiah 53.12.\x*Mingcah hnik loe anih hoi nawnto, a bantang bangah maeto, a banqoi bangah kalah maeto thinglam pongah takhing o.
Anih loe kazae kaminawk hoi kroek o hmaek tih, tiah tarik ih cabu lok to akoep boeh.
\x - \xo 15:29 \xt Saam 22.7; 109.25; \xt Mark 14.58; Jhn 2.19.\x*To ahmuen ah caeh kaminawk loe lu haek o moe, anih khaeah, Ha ha, tempul to phraek moe, ni thumto naah kasah let, nang,
nangmah hoi nangmah to amhlong ah loe, thinglam nui hoiah anghum tathuk khae, tiah padaeng o.
To baktih toengah kalen koek qaima hoi ca tarik kaminawk mah doeh, Minawk kalah loe a pahlong moe, angmah hoi angmah loe amhlong thai ai, tiah maeto hoi maeto thuih o moe, pahnuih o thuih toeng.

Kri, Israel Siangpahrang, to ka hnuk o moe, ka tang o thai hanah, thinglam nui hoiah anghum tathuk nasoe, tiah a naa o. Anih hoi nawnto thinglam pong takhing ih kami hnik mah doeh anih to padaeng hoi toeng.   
\s1 Jesu duekhaih  
\r (Mathai 27.45-56; Luka 23.44-49; Johan 19.28-30)
Atue tarukto hoi takawtto karoek to long pum ah khoving.

\x - \xo 15:34 \xt Saam 22.1.\x*Atue takawtto naah loe Jesu mah, \wj Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani,\wj* tiah tha hoi hangh, a thuih koehhaih loe, Ka Sithaw, Ka Sithaw, tipongah nang caehtaak loe? Tih haih ih ni.
A taengah angdoe thoemto kaminawk mah, to lok to thaih o naah, Khenah, Elijah mue a kawk, tiah thuih o.

\x - \xo 15:36 \xt Saam 69.21.\x*Kami maeto loe cawnh moe, lawprawn kanaem to misurtui kathaw thungah nup, cunghet nuiah takaek pacoengah, naek hanah anih to paek, anghngai o duem ah; anih lak hanah Elijah angzo tih vai, khen o si, tiah thuih o.

(hae nongpatanawk loe, Anih Kalili ah oh naah, anih hnukah bang o moe, anih ih tok to sak pae o;) anih hoi nawnto Jerusalem ah angzo paroeai kalah nongpatanawk doeh oh o.   
\s1 Jesu aphum o  
\r (Mathai 27.57-61; Luka 23.50-56; Johan 20.1-10)
Arimathea avang ih, khingya han koi kaom, rangpui mah qoih ih kami, Sithaw ukhaih prae zing kami, Joseph to angzoh, anih loe misahoihaih hoiah Pilat khaeah caeh moe, Jesu ih qok to hnik.
Anih loe duek boeh, tiah Pilat mah thaih naah dawnrai: misatuh angraeng to angmah khaeah kawk moe, anih duekhaih akra boeh maw, tiah lok a dueng.
Anih loe duek boeh tih ih lok to misatuh angraeng khae hoiah panoek naah, qok to Joseph khaeah a paek.
Joseph mah anih ih qok to lak moe, a qan ih puu kahni hoiah anih to ayaw pacoengah, thlung hoiah thuk ih taprong thungah anih to pasongh, to pacoengah taprong akhaw to thlung hoiah a kraeng.
Anih aphumhaih ahmuen loe Meri Magdalene hoi Jose ih amno Meri mah doeh panoek.

\s1 Jesu angthawhk lethaih  
\r (Mathai 28.1-8; Luka 24.1-12)
Sabbath ni boeng pacoengah, Meri Magdalene, Jakob ih amno Meri hoi Salome loe caeh hoi moe, anih ih qok to bawh hanah hmuihoih tui to a qan hoi.
Ni sarihto thung ni hmaloe koek khawnthaw, ni tacawt naah taprong ah caeh o.
To nongpatanawk loe mi mah maw taprong kraenghaih thlung to palet pae tih? tiah maeto hoi maeto a thuih o.
Nihcae mah khet o tahang naah, kamlet ving paroeai kalen, thlung to a hnuk o.
Tangqom thungah akun o naah, kasawk kahni kanglung angkhuk bantang bangah anghnu, thendoeng maeto a hnuk o; nihcae loe paroeai zit o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, Zii o hmah: thinglam nuiah takhing ih, Nazareth Jesu to na pakrong o: anih loe angthawk boeh; anih loe haeah om ai: anih pasonghaih ahmuen hae khen oh.

\x - \xo 16:7 \xt Mathai 26.32; Mark 14.28.\x*Toe caeh oh loe, a hnukbang kaminawk hoi Piter khaeah, anih loe nangcae hma ah Kalili ah caeh boeh: ang thuih o ih lok baktih toengah, to ahmuen ah anih to na hnu o tih, tiah thui pae oh, tiah a naa.
Nihcae loe tasoeh o moe, dawnrai o; karangah caeh o moe, taprong hoiah cawnh o: a zit o pongah, mi khaeah doeh thui o ai.

Nongpata loe caeh moe, Anih hoi nawnto kaom kaminawk, palungset hoi qah kaminawk khaeah thuih pae.
Anih loe hing moe, Meri Magdalene mah hnuk boeh, tiah nihcae mah thaih o naah, tang o ai.
To pacoengah anih loe vangpui bangah caeh kami hnik khaeah, krang kalah ah amkhraih moe, amtueng pae let.
Nihnik mah kalah ampuinawk khaeah thuih pae hoi, toe nihcae mah tang pae o ai.

To pacoengah anih loe kami hatlaitonawk khaeah, buh caak o naah amtueng pae let, anih angthawk pacoengah anih hnu kaminawk ih lok to tang pae o ai, palung thah o moe, tang o ai pongah nihcae to a thuitaek.
